info.title: Shem server API
info.description: Versioned HTTP contract (ADR 0013-0021). Cookie-authenticated mutations require Origin and X-CSRF-Token; bearer tokens skip CSRF. Errors are RFC 9457 problem documents. x-shem-principal names who may call an operation.

get.summary: MTA-STS policy (RFC 8461); only on mta-sts.<local domain>

post.summary: Password login; returns a pending MFA challenge (or a restricted session before any factor exists)
Recovery-code login; key-administration-only session
WebAuthn assertion options for a pending challenge
Complete MFA with a TOTP code or WebAuthn assertion
End the session and release its lease

delete.summary: Start delayed deletion of the own account (full session, step-up)

post.summary: Replace the bootstrap password; ends the session

put.summary: Change password (step-up); recovery sessions end afterwards

post.summary: Create a generated IMAP/SMTP app password, shown once (step-up)

delete.summary: Revoke an app password and its sessions (step-up)

post.summary: Create or replace the recovery code, shown once (step-up)
Begin TOTP enrollment
Confirm TOTP enrollment with a code
WebAuthn registration options
Register a WebAuthn credential

delete.summary: Remove a factor (never the last one, except in a recovery session)

post.summary: Negotiate a plaintext export (step-up); returns a single-use ticket for this session

get.summary: Stream the export as a ZIP; aborted transfers end without a ZIP central directory

post.summary: Search extracted attachment text; 409 while messages are pending unless allowIncomplete
Start a key rotation job; always re-proves the password

get.summary: Job status for its owning mailbox only

post.summary: Administrator password; returns a TOTP challenge, or a setup challenge for an initial password

200.description: OK. With setupRequired=true the challenge can only be used with /api/v1/admin/auth/setup, and totpSecret/otpauthUri carry the TOTP secret to enroll.

post.summary: Complete administrator TOTP
Complete first-login setup: replace the initial password and enroll TOTP; issues no session
End the admin session

get.summary: Listener certificate and ACME renewal state (no keys)

post.summary: Create a domain
New DKIM key under a new selector (step-up)
Provision an account; the bootstrap password is shown once

patch.summary: Change quota or state (deletion_pending needs step-up)

post.summary: Create an alias
